WELCOMEDESCRIPTION: I'm Alejandro, a 29-year-old software developer with a deep passion for technology, science, and mathematics. I'm currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science at the National University of Rosario, which allows me to deepen my understanding of both the theoretical and practical aspects of programming. I'm committed to process and system optimization, error minimization, continuous learning, and promoting Angular as a web development framework and its applications.
ANGULAR_FORMS_DESC: A complete authentication and registration system developed with Angular (frontend) and Node.js, Express, and TypeScript (backend). On the frontend, efficient form validation is implemented using Angular along with Zod, ensuring the consistency and security of the entered data. Route protection is handled through Angular Guards, ensuring that only authenticated users can access private areas. On the backend, JWT is used for secure token generation and user authentication, while Prisma handles the interaction with the MySQL database, facilitating queries and data management.
AUTH_CLIENT_DESC: The frontend is developed with Angular, using Angular Material and Material Design to create a modern and responsive interface. The Angular Forms module is implemented along with Angular Validators and custom validators to ensure validated and secure forms. Route protection is managed with Angular Guards, ensuring that only authenticated users can access private areas. Services handle business logic and communication with the backend, ensuring an efficient and organized flow of data in the application.
AUTH_SERVER_DESC: The backend is developed with Node.js, Express, and TypeScript, providing a robust and scalable architecture to handle the application's requests and responses. Zod is used for data validation, ensuring that inputs are consistent and secure before being processed. For database management, Prisma is used as the ORM, facilitating interaction with MySQL and optimizing queries and data manipulation. This combination of technologies ensures an efficient, secure, and maintainable backend.
ACTIVITY_DELEGATOR_DESC: The Activity Delegator app allows users to randomly assign activities to a group of participants, optimizing the equal distribution of tasks. This system ensures that the same participants are not repeated for the same activities for at least three days, as long as the number of activities and participants allows it.
ECOMMERCE_DESC: This Angular e-commerce application offers a modern, optimized shopping experience, leveraging the framework's power to create a harmonious and fluid front-end. It stands out from other e-commerce platforms due to its advanced admin panel, integrating real-time data and sales analysis. Users can intuitively manage products, orders, and customers, while analytical tools provide insights into trends, enabling informed decisions to maximize sales and enhance the user experience.
ECOMMERCE_CLIENT_DESC: For the client side of this e-commerce, Angular version 18 is used to leverage the latest framework features. The application takes advantage of new declarative directives @if, @for, and @switch, simplifying template logic. The inject method is also employed, and the structure is optimized through pipes, allowing the code to remain modular and clear. Responsibility is separated through services, with well-organized views and components to provide a coherent and scalable user experience.
ECOMMERCE_SERVER_DESC: This project is a server API for an eCommerce platform, developed in Node.js using the Express.js framework and structured under the Model-View-Controller (MVC) pattern. The API provides full functionality for managing products, users, shopping carts, and orders, optimized to serve as the foundation for eCommerce applications.
DEVTACORA_DESC: Devtacora is a modern and scalable blog system developed with Angular and Node.js, designed to enable the publication and organization of content through categories and subcategories. It includes dynamic views for listing posts and displaying individual articles, as well as a rating system for posts. The application is deployed on an Ubuntu server with Nginx configured as the web server, and features an automated CI/CD workflow using GitHub Actions, with separate deployments for the dev and prod branches.
THISAPP_DESC: alejandrogodino.dev is a portfolio application developed with Angular 18, created to deepen my expertise in my preferred frontend framework. In addition to showcasing my projects and experience, this app highlights my technical skills through features such as multi-language translation using ngx-translate, a configurable light and dark theme toggle, and efficient state management through observables, ensuring a smooth and reactive user interface.
PLAYERDEX_DESC: PlayerDex API is a solution developed in PHP with Laravel to manage players, their skills, and their positions within a team. It allows performing CRUD operations and includes advanced functionality to build optimized teams based on specific skills, ensuring an intuitive and secure experience. Designed to be efficient and scalable, it includes authentication with a Bearer Token to protect certain actions, such as deleting players.
